replay.detail: Stui pointer-hover highlighting adds no startup replay trigger or projection invalidation.

schema.detail: No SQLite migration, table, index or trigger change in stui pointer-hover highlighting; schema version remains 16.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules remain 11; no changed digest policy or new sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Stui adds hover paint for terminals that send motion events; motion does not activate actions or change focus. Native terminal programs retain their mouse-motion ownership. Terminals without motion retain their appearance. No API, claim or terminal-wire format requirement changes.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or measured upgrade outage is introduced by stui pointer-hover highlighting; normal daemon/client restart procedures apply.

manual.detail: Existing installations need no configuration conversion or manual data repair for stui pointer-hover highlighting.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure is introduced. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow roll-forward guidance; this fragment does not qualify binary-only rollback of the whole release.
